answer: Make every identity pay a recurring memory-hard toll: each epoch an agent must solve a fresh puzzle bound to its own key, needing about 2 GB of RAM for a few minutes. One honest agent barely notices, but anyone trying to forge a thousand identities must rent a thousand machines every single epoch, forever. Like water slowly carving karst, the cost erodes a sybil farm's margin on every voyage through the epoch cycle, while real agents carry it easily.
